items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Week 3 vs Broncos (hip/groin); did not practice all week. McVay: more unlikely than likely; expects return next week vs Eagles barring setback.
items.why: Hip/groin; full DNP week; McVay comments
items.implication: Davante Adams and other Rams WRs elevated targets/routes; sit Nacua
items.opportunity: Adams target share spike (prior 42% sans Nacua noted by Levitan)

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday vs Seahawks. Not on IR; week-to-week, aiming return ASAP after specialists; no surgery.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; McLaurin still viable but tough SEA matchup; sit Daniels
items.opportunity: Mariota game script; McLaurin 25% share historically w/ Mariota

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz elevated (30% routes/28% share prior sans Collins); sit Collins
items.opportunity: Schultz TE upside vs Colts (4th-most TE yards allowed)

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach: Warren will lead group, get breathers to stay fresh.
items.why: Toe; walking boot earlier; coach comments on rotation
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns from Rodgers (vertical failing); Homer/Heidenreich backups

items.text: Malik Nabers listed IN for Sunday; full participant Friday after prior shoulder issues.
items.implication: Start Nabers confidently; Giants offense boost post-Dart

items.text: Brock Bowers listed QUESTIONABLE for Week 3.
items.why: ETR Sunday injuries list; practiced some
items.implication: Monitor; if out, Raiders TE void; if in, start
GTD; Ravens WR depth if out
items.opportunity: If out, other BAL WRs/Andrews up

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman (ankle) ruled OUT.
items.implication: Dobbins/Harvey committee; reverse any Coleman stash; sit Coleman
items.opportunity: Healthier backs reclaim snaps from Coleman prior 83%

items.text: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold off injury report (glute) and good to go at Washington.
items.implication: Full Seahawks offense; Jadarian Price also IN per ETR

items.text: With Dowdle out, expecting Jaylen Warren to lead; vertical pass game failing for Rodgers so spam Warren checkdowns. Practice squad Homer + rookie Heidenreich as backups.
items.why: Coach: Warren lead + fresh; Rodgers inefficiency
items.opportunity: High snap/target share as lead + receiving

items.text: Packers WRs sans Reed (TNF): Watson 45 routes, Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: Route data first game without Reed
items.implication: Watson/Golden locked-in volume; start Watson confidently
items.opportunity: High route share, red-zone for Watson

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
ETR Week 3 projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg top 25th %ile sim outcomes). Similar base only prior CMC.
items.why: Sim ceiling record; projections update for news

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets/8% share through 3 games. TPRR: 33% London off, 17% London on. Long-time fade.
items.implication: Fade Pitts; London dominates when on
items.opportunity: London high target share/avgs w/ Penix
